unpublished_api_decision.consumer_audit: Before mutation, repository symbol search found only the candidate module/tests, lib reexports and this scope artifact. git branch --contains found only porting/independent-meshvs-topology; git tag --contains returned no tags. No existing released API consumer found.
unpublished_api_decision.version_policy: Candidate refinement before integration/publication; no released API or package version changed. Historical mutable ownership is not a replay mode of this new API.
unpublished_api_decision.invalid_counts: Every i32 count below 3 returns TooFewBasePoints including operation and requested count; historical null rows map to this explicit failure. No successful empty result.
unpublished_api_decision.overflow: Prism requires n <= i32::MAX / 2 + 1 (last node 2n-1); pyramid requires n <= i32::MAX-1 (last face n+1). Checked storage arithmetic and per-vector isize byte limits run before allocation. Exceeding a bound returns IndexOverflow.
unpublished_api_decision.allocation: Two try_reserve_exact calls run before filling topology. AllocationFailure retains TryReserveError and operation/count; no partial result is published. Resource-exhausting allocations are not attempted in tests, and OS overcommit/process termination cannot be caught.
unpublished_api_decision.fixture_policy: The original 26 rows and SHA256 remain unchanged. First 24 rows assert exact face ordering and rejection correspondence; last two mutable-handle rows remain provenance only and are explicitly excluded from immutable API ownership assertions.
unpublished_api_decision.geometry_policy: Only integer combinatorial connectivity is constructed. No geometric input, measured error, tolerance, healing, entity history, geometry validation, model operation receipt or kernel publication acceptance is claimed.
